scope: every stable NON-CLIQUE PROPER support at n = 7. By Theorem F a proper support is stable iff the induced subgraph has a stable positive full support and the off-support condition (2) holds; the only non-clique induced subgraphs with a stable positive full support have 6 nodes and are the three verified n = 6 counterexamples (no 5-node or smaller ones exist). So every such (graph, support) pair is one of the three bases on the support plus a 7th node with one of 4096 in/out patterns; the bases have trivial automorphism groups, so all 12,288 pairs are distinct up to isomorphism.
method: region2d on the support {0..5} with the off-support polynomial o_6 in the boundary set, cross-checked pointwise, root counts replayed; 0 escalations
status: certified; the n = 6 bases are hand-verified; the 7-node pairs were not individually hand-verified
